svg.title: Dense and mixture-of-experts scaling
svg.desc: A dense model activates all parameters for every token, while a mixture-of-experts model routes each token to a small subset of a larger capacity pool.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: MoE Adds a New Scaling Dimension
Total capacity and per-token compute no longer have to be equal
One compute path through the full network
Router selects a few experts per token
Blue experts are active for this token
Per-token compute scales mainly with active parameters, plus routing and communication.
